critical_code_review_comments: gift_cards.py:_schedule_gc_gift_email correctly guards on bg + gifted_to_email presence and always resolves buyer name safely (fallback 'A friend'). Good defensive coding.
gift_cards.py:_issue_card correctly resolves owner_user_id when gifted_to_email matches an existing user — enables wallet-inbox pickup for known recipients without breaking anonymous-email gifts.
gift_cards.py catalog seed products use POINTS_PER_DOLLAR=100 (10 pts per cent). Denominations $10/$25/$50 cost 1000/2500/5000 pts — reasonable for the test@ user with existing balance.

GiftInboxSection.jsx keyframes injected inline via <style> — works but consider moving to a global stylesheet if the widget mounts on multiple pages (double-injection would be harmless but duplicated).
ShopHomeWidget.jsx filters items by cover_url presence before slice(0,4) — hides tiles without covers correctly; renders null when no items, avoiding empty state noise on new deployments.

Mobile shop/giftcards/[id].tsx uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as origin_url for Stripe — this is the API host; success_url will land on the API host root path /payment/success. Works because backend is on same host as web preview but for a standalone native build without a web frontend this would 404. Consider passing a web-frontend URL for success/cancel handling.
mobile wallet.tsx: LayoutAnimation with UIManager.setLayoutAnimationEnabledExperimental gated to Android only — correct.
